hero.alt: Does Music Break Wudu on a soft green background

sources.title: Darul Ifta Birmingham: ablution and answering a phone
sources.supports: The Hanafi answer enumerates wudu nullifiers and explains that answering a call does not itself invalidate wudu. Hearing or listening is not included in that list.

sources.title: Egypt’s Dar Al-Ifta: Listening to music and songs
sources.supports: The institution distinguishes permitted and prohibited music according to content and circumstances; this ruling does not establish wudu nullification.

sources.title: Darul Ifta Birmingham: Going to the gym that plays music
sources.supports: This institution advises avoiding a gym playing music, illustrating a more restrictive position on listening, separate from ritual purity.
